facts.text: If it is meant to be, fate will find us. I would like it to find us before the check.
facts.why: It is Sara who lets fate decide, while Jonathan is the one asking for her number. The note's stance suits Sara more than Jonathan.
facts.fix: If it is meant to be, fate will find us. I would like it to find us before the check. (by Sara Thomas)
